flags: STATUS (manual group, not written - reviewer to update): parks.ky.gov/improvements, read 2026-11-23: 'Green River Lake State Park campground reopening TBD 2027' and 'Green River Lake State Park campground is open to limited primitive and self-contained units until October 31, 2026 with no electrical service at sites.' Stored status 'open ... through Oct 31, 2026; closed for restoration after, full reopening spring 2027' is now past its end date. Suggest status -> operating 'closed', reopens 2027 (no date given), note 'closed for flood restoration of the electrical system after Oct 31, 2026; reopening TBD 2027 (parks.ky.gov)'. CONTRADICTION: ReserveAmerica still shows 'Status: Open through Tue Dec 15 2026' and sells June 2027 nights (no-electric sites $30, electric sites $32-38), so 2027 bookings are already being taken.

WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE RECOMMENDED (stored lakefront -> lakeview): the campground sits on an open grass peninsula, but on Esri imagery every pad is on the inland side of the lake-side road or the north loop road, with open mowed ground beyond. USGS 3DEP 1-m lidar (lake surface flattened at 206.4 m at flight, about summer pool 675 ft): the closest pads, at the lake end of the first row (map sites 166/165, ~37.27665,-85.31775), are 3.6 m above the water 35 m away with the loop road between; the lake-road pads near 84/85 and 12/13 (~37.27616,-85.31716) 4.9 m above at ~48 m; profiles from 37.27569,-85.31655 (70 m, 4.4 m), 37.27530,-85.31606 (70 m, 4.6 m), 37.27622,-85.31727 (50 m, 4.8 m), 37.27464,-85.31539 east loop (45 m, 4.0 m, partly treed). A road lies between every site and the water, which the About-panel definition counts as a view; the gentle grass slope would otherwise be an easy walk, so a reviewer could keep lakefront with a caveat naming the first-row sites. The low-water Esri tile shows a wide bare drawdown apron - measured to the high-water edge, not to it.
